headline: Fuels: 40-Cent Cut on Heating Oil, 20 on Diesel and 10 on Unleaded – Subsidy Increased by 30% | News
summary: Greece will cut heating oil by 40 cents, diesel by 20 cents and unleaded by 10 cents, with subsidies raised by 30%. The fiscal cost for the second half of October is estimated at 46 million euros.
why: Fuel subsidies affect household and transport costs and draw on the public budget, which matters for Greek fiscal policy and inflation.
